enabled.description: Enable the fetchinfo_plugin in Claws Mail.

headers.description: List of headers to add with download information. Each entry corresponds to one of the documented X-FETCH-* headers. All five are enabled by default per plugin documentation, but may be selectively disabled if needed (though the plugin does not officially support disabling individual headers — this is added for extensibility/flexibility in deployment configs). Only 'enabled' and 'name' are documented; 'description' is illustrative for clarity in configs. Note: Actual plugin behavior adds all five headers unconditionally when enabled, per manual page; this schema supports theoretical selective control while remaining compliant with documented behavior. In practice, 'enabled' in header items should always be true to match real-world plugin behavior.

timestamp_format.description: Format of the X-FETCH-TIME header. Only 'RFC-822' is supported as per man page.
